The audit report generation failed because the Word summary document did not include the required high-priority facility-session combinations.
The run failed with a verifier reward of 0.00 due to an AssertionError in test_word_summary_content. Specifically, 'assert mentioned >= 2' failed with 'assert 0 >= 2', indicating the Word summary (.docx) failed to mention at least two high-priority facility-session combinations. While 5 tests passed, including basic file generation, the summary content lacked the specific facility-session strings (e.g., 'FAC-SESS') required by the audit logic. Avoid omitting session-specific identifiers in the final narrative summary.
